title: Surface gravitational acceleration
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as g = v²/(2h).

title: Mars mass derivation
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's law of gravitation (g = GM/R²) to relate g to M.

title: Mars mass answer
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as M = (v²R²)/(2Gh).

title: Density calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the spherical volume formula V = (4/3)πR³ to find density ρ = M/V.

title: Mars density answer
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly expressed as ρ = (3v²)/(8πGhR).

title: Kinematic equation application
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the kinematic equation v² = 2gh to find g from the drop.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final answers should have correct and consistent units for acceleration, mass, and density.

title: Sign or formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Penalize using an incorrect kinematic equation (e.g., v = gt) or misapplying the gravitational law (e.g., using R+h instead of R).
